verdicts.observation: The line layout was changed. The source (tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/chemistry.lua:32-35) has 3 line breaks, each followed by \t\t. The target has only 2: it merges 'You will learn a new schematic at level 1.' and the next line into one line, and the first break is followed by a single \t. This breaks the newline and indentation invariant.

The source long_desc (tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua:1505, DEATH_FROM_ABOVE, a beneficial self effect) says the bearer 'launching a powerful rocket barrage each turn'. The target drops this automatic per-turn barrage. In its place it adds '可手动使用火箭弹幕再次发射' and '使用其他任何技能会立即结束该效果', which are not in the source, and the frozen evidence does not support them. It also calls the self-buff bearer '目标'. The translation does not match the source description.

Three meaning errors in dominion-port.lua:24-48. (1) 'Ogric brandy' is translated as '兽人白兰地', but Ogric refers to ogres (食人魔), not orcs. (2) 'Swabbie Grogbreath, violation of loss of liquor privileges' is translated as '违反免除饮酒', which is garbled. The source means he broke the earlier penalty of losing his drinking privileges. (3) The nickname 'Dogchucker' (someone who throws dogs) is translated as '狗门卫', which does not match the source.

Terminology mismatch. The frozen terminology entry (terminology/talents.tsv:210, preferred, notes say the weapon reference in the heavy-weapons description should match the talent name) gives Flamethrower=火焰喷射器. The #AQUAMARINE# label in the target uses '喷火器', while the body of the same line uses '火焰喷射器'. Also, the source 'flechettes' deal acid damage, but the target switches from '镖弹' to '毒镖', and '毒' (poison) is not in the source.

The source (world-artifacts.lua:465) says 'You'll be able to remember it pretty easily if you lose it', meaning that if you lose it you can easily recall it. The target '当你丢掉它时你就记住它了' says you will remember it once you lose it. This drops both 'be able to' and 'pretty easily', turning the joke into a plain statement of fact.

The source achievement condition (achievements/special.lua:35, ORCS_MERCY) is 'without any civilians deaths', meaning no civilian may die from any cause. The target '但不杀死其他居民' narrows this to 'you do not kill other residents', which changes the condition. It also renders 'civilians' as '其他居民' ('other residents').

The target drops conditions that affect the mechanic (gunslinging.lua:250-253). (1) '(or until it misses)': the ricochet chain ends early on a miss. (2) The bounce rules 'foes you can see' and 'whenever it hits something solid (creature or solid wall), it will bounce towards the next closest foe'. These are reduced to '子弹命中后将弹射至其他目标上'. (3) 'cunning and dexterity' is shortened to '灵敏', which loses cunning.
